name: neutron-marketplace-protocol
description: Neutron marketplace and authenticated package-source protocol

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && bun scripts/test-ash.ts && bun scripts/test-integration.ts
scripts.local:install: icp canister install marketplace -e local --mode install --wasm build/marketplace.wasm
scripts.local:upgrade: icp canister install marketplace -e local --mode upgrade --wasm-memory-persistence keep --wasm build/marketplace.wasm
scripts.icp:install: icp canister install marketplace --mode install --wasm build/marketplace.wasm
scripts.icp:upgrade: icp canister install marketplace --mode upgrade --wasm-memory-persistence keep --wasm build/marketplace.wasm
